decisions.scope: Regular 2000 Donruss Football only; exclude separate Elite, Preferred and Quantum Leaf products. 1278 staged cards in 22 families; separate 53-card Authentic Stamp namespace withheld as unresolved, with all raw rows retained in source.json. This is not a fully verified master inventory until that question is resolved.
decisions.rookies: 100 true base RCs #151-250, all /1325, cross-checked complete rookie index and both independent base rosters. No inferred RCs on inserts or parallels.
decisions.numbering: Retain primary catalogue numbers, which may differ from physical prefixes and other catalogues. NNO-CID identifiers are explicitly local stable IDs. Full printed-number harvest pending.
decisions.teams: Every base/parallel identity and team checked. Independent rosters establish historical affiliations, including Los Angeles Rams for Dickerson. Correct three erroneous autograph-team entries using independent Gold roster and selected originals, including Doug Chapman Blue back.
decisions.serials: Retain every individual Stat Line and Zoning Red source limit. Signed Studio first-50 allocation is not necessarily printed /50. Randy Moss PR19 differs from printed /250. Red signatures have announced PR, not serial numbers.
decisions.sourceLimits: MCB actual tables cover 521 rows despite 581 headline; LastSticker covers 574 rows. Neither is a complete master. Source retrieval of Beckett redirected to a service-status page and is not treated as checklist evidence. Catalogue-level coverage and selected originals, not visual verification of every card.
decisions.packConfiguration: Hobby 18 packs x16 cards; retail 24x7 differs. Career denominator unresolved 24 versus25; other undocumented odds null. Serial quantities never substitute for insertion odds. No pack-engine changes.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft only; pricing, images, unresolved Authentic Stamp, full printed prefixes and historical collation require QA. No production DB access or deployment.
